mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(attendee_count), 0) FROM ( SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dtl_attendance a WHERE a.session_id = s.id AND a.deleted = FALSE AND a.attend_status = #{attendPresent}) AS attendee_count FROM biz_training_session s WHERE s.deleted = FALSE AND s.lecturer_id = #{lecturerId} AND s.session_state IN #{s} ) t
SELECT ROUND(AVG(f.score)::NUMERIC, 1) FROM dtl_training_feedback f JOIN biz_training_session s ON s.id = f.session_id AND s.deleted = FALSE WHERE f.deleted = FALSE AND s.lecturer_id = #{lecturerId}
SELECT ROUND(AVG(score)::NUMERIC, 1) FROM dtl_training_feedback WHERE deleted = FALSE
SELECT ROUND(AVG(score)::NUMERIC, 1) FROM dtl_trial_feedback WHERE deleted = FALSE AND trial_id = #{trialId}
